automatic_reject: Service creates external collaborator instead of receiving it
HTTP handler contains business workflow or SQL without explicit justified exception
Invented APIs or fabricated test result
passing_rule: For a real agent run, score applicable dimensions (0/1/2) and require >= 83% of available points, no applicable automatic-reject violations, and independently rerun relevant tests. Mark N/A rather than zero for inapplicable architecture/DI. Do not assign a score until code output and command logs have been collected.
required_evidence: Exact baseline repo commit and model+agent versions
Full git diff and created file tree
Production composition root and one verified runtime path
Test commands and independently observed exit codes
Explicit NOT RUN checks and risks
applicability: For every evaluation dimension, first decide APPLICABLE / NOT APPLICABLE from actual language, paradigm and task. Do not penalize absent HTTP handlers, class constructors, database repositories or DI when the software has no such responsibility. When a task has external collaborators, require explicit supply, usage, production assembly and substitution regardless of programming language.
language_coverage: Cases include many languages and paradigms; presence of a prompt is not evidence the agent behaves correctly in that language.
